8 of the 23 sites are load-bearing fixture preconditions (Kind P) where one clone is strictly behind the peer; these must be converted from _engine_run to deterministic checked git fetch + ff-only merge

15 of the 23 sites are read-side sync behavior under test (Kind R) where the reconvergence through the production read path is the assertion target; converting them would delete the invariant they prove
_sync_from_origin helper exists but is defined late (line 1680); it must move to the helper block to be available before first use at the 8 Kind-P conversion sites

A separate category of 18 raw _git(push) calls including one in _assert_emit_is_append_only exists outside the 23-site audit; these are fail-fast (check=True) and not sync-by-side-effect, so they represent an orthogonal failure mode
Tests pass with REBAR_SYNC_PULL=off after the conversion, proving every converted Kind-P precondition now lands deterministically even when the best-effort read path is disabled
